title: DeepTeam - Free Open Source LLM Red Teaming Framework (Automated Security Testing)
description:
DeepTeam is a free, open-source alternative to enterprise red-teaming services. It automatically attacks your LLMs to find vulnerabilities like bias, data leaks, and jailbreaks. Runs locally, includes 50+ tests and 20+ attack methods. Perfect for teams building AI agents. More like this → gittrend.io
